verdict.rationale: Replication and high availability are fair questions for a vector database or lakehouse, so the axis applies. The pack has no evidence of cross-node or cross-zone replication, HA failover, or a documented consistency model. The storage docs only say LanceDB can run on NVMe, EBS, EFS, or S3-compatible object stores, and the versioning and branching docs cover table history, not replication or consistency guarantees.
